name: Primus Telecommunications Australia
summary: Australian arm of US PTGi; among the first carriers licensed at full deregulation in July 1997 (entered via Axicorp 1996); ran its own fibre in the five capitals; launched the iPrimus consumer brand 1999; acquired by M2 Group (June 2012), later part of Vocus. Acquired Imagineering's data centre business (2008) (PRIMUS TELECOMMUNICATIONS PTY LIMITED, ACN 071 191 396).

events.details: One of the first carriers licensed when competition opened in Australia (1 July 1997); entered via Axicorp 1996.
Acquired by M2 Group for A$192.4m (announced 16 Apr 2012, completed 1 Jun 2012); M2 merged into Vocus 2016.
